title: Unhinged Craft
description: Unhinged Craft adds a collection of chaotic and fun features to Minecraft, including tornadoes, sandfalls, nukes, custom items, new gamerules, powerful enchantments, and even cursed negative enchantments. It's designed to make your world more unpredictable
body:
Welcome to Unhinged Craft 🌪️💥  

Unhinged Craft is a content mod that adds a variety of random, chaotic, and entertaining features to Minecraft. Whether you want natural disasters, overpowered gear, dangerous enchantments, or world-changing explosions, this mod brings a little bit of everything.  

Features  
🌪️ Tornadoes that can wreak havoc across your world.  
🏜️ Sandfalls and other unusual environmental events.  
☢️ Nukes capable of creating massive destruction.  
🧰 Custom Items with unique abilities and uses.  
⚙️ New Gamerules for additional customization.  
✨ Powerful Enchantments that can enhance your gameplay.  
💀 Negative Enchantments that add risk, challenge, and chaos.  
🎲 More random and unexpected features designed to keep every world interesting.  
Why download Unhinged Craft?  

This mod doesn't focus on a single theme. Instead, it adds a mix of features that are fun, ridiculous, useful, destructive, and sometimes completely unnecessary. If you've ever wanted a Minecraft experience that's a little less normal and a lot more chaotic, Unhinged Craft is for you.  

Expect the unexpected. After all, it's called Unhinged Craft for a reason. 😈🌪️💥
